001: Did you see what Maria posted in her stories yesterday?
No, I barely use social media these days.
Really? But you used to post things all the time.
Yeah, but I realized it takes up too much time.
So what do you do in your free time now?
I read books and walk in the park, it's calmer for me.
002: Subscribe to our Telegram channel, all the group news is there.
What do they post there besides the schedule?
They post materials for seminars and lecture recordings.
And you can also ask the teacher a question there.
003: Why aren't you answering the messages in the chat?
Sorry, I turned off the notifications, there's too much spam.
I understand, but we were discussing an important project.
I saw it, I already read everything I needed.
So what do you think of our plan?
I think it needs a bit more work.
004: Are you a member of any online communities?
Yes, I'm in a photography lovers group.
Sounds interesting. What do they discuss there?
They share photos, give advice on gear, and sometimes hold contests.
And do you take part in those contests?
I took second place once, it felt really nice.
005: I noticed you deleted your old posts.
Yeah, I decided to clean up my page.
Why? There were some good photos on there.
But there was also a lot of extra stuff that I don't like anymore.
Well, it's your right, of course.
Now I try to post only what really matters.
006: Can you send me the link to that forum?
Sure, I'll send it to you in a private message right now.
Thanks. Do you need to register there?
Yes, but it'll only take a couple of minutes.
Yeah, there are always a lot of people online, especially in the evening.
007: Why haven't you posted the photos from our trip?
I haven't had a chance to edit them yet.
Come on, hurry up, everyone's waiting.
Okay, I'll definitely post them tonight.
And don't forget to tag me in the photos.
Of course, you came out really well in them.
008: Did you see the new post on our shared blog?
Not yet, what's interesting about it?
They wrote about the conference results.
Great, I'll have to read it.
Seriously? Then I'm reading it right now.
009: What do you think about anonymous comments on the internet?
I think they often lead to rudeness.
I agree, people get too carried away.
That's why I try not to read the comments under the news.
And that's the right thing to do, sometimes people write such awful stuff there.
It's better to discuss everything with friends in person.
010: Did you create the group for our project yet?
Yes, I made it yesterday evening.
And who did you add to it?
So far just the four of us, I'll add the rest later.
Of course, I already put our work plan in there.
